pre-register one variable with mechanism and strongest same-capacity control
run bounded engineering checks while training is closed
evaluate efficacy only with authorized training and independent held-out labels
meaningful_improvement_targets: reduce pose/shape ambiguity under limited observations
improve calibrated predictive distribution and complete-state decision
reduce resources only with retained validation quality
inherit_acceptance: flow_research_plan_v1.json and flow_next_config_v1.json; do not replace held-out criteria by fixture checks
